prompt: Add a /api/health endpoint to the Express server that returns JSON with uptime (in seconds), status ('ok'), and timestamp. The endpoint should be added to server/index.js. Also write a unit test for it in tests/unit/health-endpoint.test.js using vitest.

assertions.name: returns_json_structure
assertions.description: Endpoint returns JSON with uptime, status, and timestamp fields

assertions.name: test_file_exists
assertions.description: Unit test file exists at tests/unit/health-endpoint.test.js

assertions.name: test_passes
assertions.description: Tests pass when running npm test
